content: Letermovir has been shown to increase the levels of various medications by inhibiting the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4, as well as through other mechanisms such as OATP1B1/3 inhibition. Below are the specific interactions and recommendations for monitoring or adjusting therapy: 1. Dofetilide: Letermovir increases dofetilide levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 2. Dolasetron: Letermovir increases dolasetron levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Exercise caution and monitor. 3. Donepezil: Letermovir raises donepezil levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Monitor carefully. 4. Doxorubicin: Letermovir elevates doxorubicin levels through CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 5. Dronabinol: Letermovir increases dronabinol levels by affecting CYP3A4. Monitor closely. 6. Dutasteride: Letermovir raises dutasteride levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Use caution and monitor. 7. Efavirenz: Letermovir increases efavirenz levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Monitor carefully. 8. Elbasvir/Grazoprevir: Letermovir increases levels of these drugs through OATP1B1/3 inhibition. Monitor closely. 9. Eltrombopag: Eltrombopag increases letermovir levels by reducing its metabolism. Use caution and monitor. 10. Eluxadoline: Letermovir raises eluxadoline levels via OATP1B1/3 inhibition. Monitor closely. 11. Empagliflozin: Letermovir increases empagliflozin levels through an unspecified mechanism. Monitor glucose concentrations. 12. Enalapril: Letermovir elevates enalapril levels via OATP1B1/3 inhibition. Monitor closely. 13. Encorafenib: Encorafenib increases letermovir levels and toxicities by inhibiting OATP1B1/3. Adjust therapy and monitor closely. 14. Erythromycin: Erythromycin increases letermovir levels by reducing its metabolism. Letermovir also raises erythromycin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Monitor carefully. 17. Esomeprazole: Letermovir elevates esomeprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. 18. Estradiol: Letermovir increases estradiol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition. Monitor closely. 19. Eszopiclone: Letermovir raises eszopiclone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Use caution and monitor. 20. Ethosuximide: Letermovir increases ethosuximide levels via CYP3A4 inhibition. Monitor for myopathy and rhabdomyolysis. Dosage reduction may be necessary. 35. Fosaprepitant: Letermovir raises fosaprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4. Monitor closely. 36.
